Whipping_Mycelial_Tendril_Tail.description: The Whipping Mycelial Tendril Tail is a writhing, fungal appendage that coils and uncoils with preternatural grace, its mycelium-infused core granting its bearer unparalleled dexterity and reach, while its razor-sharp edges prowl for opportunities to initiate a relentless bleed effect or to entangle foes in a powerful grapple.

Toxic_Spores_Puffball_Tail.description: The Toxic Spores Puffball Tail is a grotesque fungal appendage that trails behind its host, releasing a haze of noxious spores capable of incapacitating foes with a mere waft of its toxic cloud, while the host gains a twisted resilience to the perils of the darkened forest.

Cordyceps_Stinger_Tail.description: The Cordyceps Stinger Tail is a grotesque fungal appendage that sprouts from the host's lower back, writhing with malevolent intent and pulsating with a sickly green glow, granting enhanced agility and strength while enabling the wielder to unleash a poisonous cloud and deliver devastating true strikes.

Decaying_Wood_Club_Tail.description: This withered appendage, covered in a thick layer of fungal growth and oozing with the essence of decay, grants its bearer immense physical strength but at the cost of agility, as it drags and hinders movement. The tail's dark magic allows the wielder to unleash devastating blows capable of knocking down even the hardiest of foes and sundering armor and shields alike.

Bioluminescent_Glow_Lure_Tail.description: The Bioluminescent Glow Lure Tail is a mesmerizing fungal appendage that pulses with an ethereal light, enhancing both wisdom and charisma as it emits a captivating glow to attract and charm creatures from the shadows.

Slime_Mold_Amorphous_Tail.description: This amorphous, fungal tail is a squirming mass of translucent slime, capable of stretching and contracting with preternatural dexterity, granting its bearer increased agility and the ability to traverse even the most treacherous terrain with ease, while also allowing for powerful grapples and entanglements.

Hardened_Shelf_Fungus_Blade_Tail.description: Bristling with razor-sharp spines and ending in a hardened blade, this fungal tail is a menacing appendage that grants its bearer enhanced strength and natural armor, while also providing defensive and offensive capabilities through the Bleed Procc and Block skills.

Vibrant_Amanita_Rattle_Tail.description: The Vibrant Amanita Rattle Tail is a mesmerizing fungal appendage, its iridescent hues shifting like a toxic aurora as it sways, filled with a hollow rattle that sends shivers of fear through the hearts of those who behold it, while also hinting at a profound, unsettling wisdom and charm.

Crystalline_Underdark_Fungus_Tail.description: This entity wields a luminescent tail, born from the dark fungal growths of the Underdark, encrusted with sharp, crystalline nodes that reflect magical energies back at their source, granting the bearer enhanced wisdom and constitution, as well as the ability to see in darkness and reflect harmful spells.

Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Tail.description: The Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Tail is a wispy, ethereal appendage that trails behind like a translucent shadow, granting its bearer unparalleled stealth and a spectral aura that camouflages them against the ghostly backdrop of forgotten realms.
